prompt: Write a function named validate_password that compares an actual password with a typed password by checking if every character matches. The function accepts the following parameters: actual_password (string, required) - the correct password to compare against; typed_password (string, required) - the password entered by the user to validate. Compare passwords character by character. On success, return a boolean value: true if passwords match exactly (case-sensitive, including whitespace), false otherwise. On error, return an appropriate error indicator for your language (e.g., a specific error value, exception, or error type).
implementation_details: Language: Python. Use Python. Return boolean values (True/False). Return the string "Error" for error cases.
